basis:
Card carries no tradition/system field; the card frames a referendum question (assessment first published July 2015, firmed February 2016) with stated mundane material — UK national charts of 1066, 1801 and 1922 available, and Uranus conjunct Ceres at 23 degrees Aries on referendum day — decided as Western mundane astrology. Card facts also record February 2016 polls showing 'Stay' ahead with many undecided; the astrological material, not the polls, is the operative input for this source's call.
Reading: Uranus is the disruption/separation planet; a Uranus conjunction in cardinal Aries (self-assertion, breaking away) operating on referendum day against the UK charts — whose 1801 chart is built on a Capricorn/Saturn union structure — reads as a rupture of the existing union arrangement rather than its confirmation. Ceres with Uranus adds a severing-of-nourishment/terms-of-membership colouring. A status-quo (Stay) call would require a Saturnian confirmation signature, which the card does not supply.
[Section 8 quantity check] Lines: Uranus–Ceres conjunction in Aries on the day (supporting rupture/Leave, timed exactly to the vote); the availability and use of the 1801 union chart as the entity being disrupted (supporting); polls for Stay (pressing against — noted, but polls are not this source's method input). Main line: the Uranus disruption line acting on the UK-union object. Band: a Leave win by a modest, not overwhelming, margin band — the pressing polling line caps the grade below a landslide call; no percentage is derivable and none is stated.
prediction_text: Main call: Britain votes to LEAVE the European Union in the referendum of 23 June 2016. The result goes against the February polling lead for 'Stay': the undecided bloc breaks disproportionately for Leave under the referendum-day Uranus configuration, and the United Kingdom's membership is voted to an end. Timing fixed by the question: decided 23 June 2016. Margin layer: a close Leave win rather than a rout (lower confidence than the direction call itself).
